content.title: Flat Cocoa Drink Ad | Pour-Driven Graphic Rhythm and Product Proof
content.summary: An indigo tea pour becomes a clean flat-poster headline. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One liquid family drives both product formation and graphic transition. + The package causes the visible fill action and then returns upright. + Cup, package and ingredient motifs reconnect before typography takes over. + The liquid wipe reveals exact readable text instead of covering or mutating it. + The final flat poster holds product, package, motif and claim together.
quick_start.recommended_input: Animate indigo tea droplets falling across a pale sand field and collecting inside one clear outlined cup. Reconnect the full cup, upright sachet, two mint leaves and one coral accent splash in a balanced flat layout. Hold headline, short line "ONE CUP, ONE CLEAN PAUSE", cup and sachet together as the final poster.
